name: cobol-copy-replacing-operand-subscript
body: pairs wraps a non-pseudo-text COPY REPLACING operand (a word or literal with its OF/IN qualifiers and an optional parenthesised subscript) as one pseudo-text, consuming from an opening parenthesis to the next closing one. Limit: unbalanced or nested parentheses in an operand swallow tokens to the end of the clause. Upgrade to balanced parenthesis matching when a corpus uses nested subscripts or reference modification in REPLACING operands.
